population_note_text: Books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded); Contra excluded throughout. A loan ledger's interest journals are vouchers whose only other ledger lines are its configured interest ledger or ledgers (the client's list of loans) and any ledger the client configures as TDS payable; every other voucher touching the loan ledger is a taken (credit) or repaid (debit) transaction, never classified by ledger name.

figures.definition_text: Sum of the repayments that Clause 31(c) reports: entries on a loan from a lender outside the form's reporting exemption, where the balance being repaid, with or without the interest credited and not yet paid, or the repayment itself reaches the s.269SS/269T limit.
Debits to loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) other than its interest journals -- amount repaid in the year, before any Clause 31/s.269T lender-exemption or mode filter.
Loan taken on voucher (tag 211d12ab) against loan ledger (tag 977bdd42).
Loan taken on voucher (tag ca3b7e25) against loan ledger (tag 977bdd42).
Form 3CD utility Note 1 code for this taken entry: derived from the mode and direction, not read off a specimen utility export -- confirm.
Form 3CD utility Note 1 code for this taken entry: derived from the mode and direction, not read off a specimen utility export -- confirm.
Mode of this taken transaction, read from its counter-line ledger group(s): cash/bank if any counter-line is under that group, else journal if the voucher's own type is Journal, else other.
Mode of this taken transaction, read from its counter-line ledger group(s): cash/bank if any counter-line is under that group, else journal if the voucher's own type is Journal, else other.
Outstanding balance owed to the lender on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) immediately after this entry (prior balance 0p plus this entry's amount) -- the GN 55.8/57.2 running-balance walk.
Outstanding balance owed to the lender on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) immediately after this entry (prior balance 3000000p plus this entry's amount) -- the GN 55.8/57.2 running-balance walk.

Sum of the loans taken that Clause 31(a) reports: entries on a loan from a lender outside the form's reporting exemption, from where the running balance with that lender reaches the s.269SS/269T limit, or whose own amount does.
Credits to loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) other than its interest journals -- amount taken/accepted in the year, before any Clause 31/s.269SS lender-exemption or mode filter.

Whether the assessee must deduct TDS under s.194A for the year -- the same rule and figure as 'TDS on payments made': firm/LLP/company always; individual/HUF only if previous-year business turnover exceeded the rules' turnover limit for an individual or HUF.

The configured interest ledger name(s) for loan ledger (tag 977bdd42), one per line, or '' if the loan is interest-free -- this test's own consistency checks read them back to check each voucher on this loan and its interest ledger(s) independently of the test's own bucketing.

Interest paid/credited on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42): sum of every voucher whose only other lines are its configured interest ledger(s) and any ledger in the client's statutory dues classified as TDS payable, counted before that TDS.
Lender type for loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) from the client's list of loans, classified by the loan ledger this interest pairs with -- never by a word in the ledger name.
Ledgers under Loans (Liability), other than bank and cash ledgers, that moved in the year and are not in the client's list of loans (each has a notice).
Credits in the year to ledger (tag bb7e7b30), under Loans (Liability) and not in the client's list of loans (Contra vouchers excluded, as throughout this test).
Debits in the year to ledger (tag bb7e7b30), under Loans (Liability) and not in the client's list of loans (Contra vouchers excluded, as throughout this test).

Ledgers that moved in the year, are not in the client's list of loans and are not bank or cash ledgers, whose Tally group chain is incomplete: whether each is under Loans (Liability) cannot be told, so neither notice is raised for it.

Ledgers under Current Liabilities, Sundry Creditors or Suspense A/c, not in the client's list of loans, with bank debits of one amount in 3 or more months narrated with ACH, NACH, ECS or EMI (each has a notice).

Running maximum of the outstanding balance owed to the lender on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) during the year (opening balance, then after every taken/repaid entry in date order) -- the utility's MaxAmtOsAccPy column.

Whether the TDS on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) covers the s.194A rate on its interest: covered, partly covered, none, or not judged where the rules carry no s.194A rate. The rate assumes the lender furnished a PAN: s.206AA's higher rate is not applied, and the books do not show a PAN.
The TDS on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42) that covers its interest: each deduction counts only against interest credited on or before its own date, up to the s.194A rate on that interest.
TDS at the s.194A rate (1000 basis points) on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42)'s interest.
Loan ledgers with a non-exempt lender whose interest this year exceeds the s.194A threshold and for which the assessee is a deductor.
Reportable taken/repaid rows in cash/journal/other mode at or over the s.269SS/269T limit (₹20,000).
TDS deducted on loan ledger (tag 977bdd42): the lines on ledgers in the client's statutory dues classified as TDS payable, on every voucher that posts to the loan.

findings.title_text: Loan taken against invented NBFC, not a real entity (cash mode, code B) -- at or over the s.269SS/269T running-balance limit
limits_text: Books only: confirm the lender's identity (name, address, PAN) for Form 3CD Clause 31, and whether this lender is excepted from s.269SS/269T beyond the lender types the rules already except (Government, a notified corporation, or another body notified under the Explanation).

The mode-and-direction code follows the Form 3CD utility's own Note 1 list (A/B cash payment/receipt, I/J journal entry debit/credit, K/L any other mode debit/credit); this pack's own mapping from mode and direction to that code is a derivation from the GN's text, not verified against a specimen utility export -- confirm.

Mode is read from the counter-line ledger's group only (Cash-in-Hand), never from the narration: this voucher's narration is 'Synthetic voucher R/8'. A narration naming an electronic instrument (e.g. UPI/PhonePe) booked through a cash ledger takes this outside s.269SS/269T even though the ledger group says 'cash' -- confirm from the narration and the bank statement before treating this as a cash breach.
s.273B reasonable cause (e.g. banking facilities not available in the area) is a CA judgement call on the facts, not a books fact.
ask_client_text: Confirm lender identity (name, address, PAN) for Clause 31.
Confirm from narration/bank statement whether this was genuinely cash or an electronic transfer narrated against a cash ledger.

findings.title_text: Deductor status for s.194A depends on previous-year turnover
limits_text: An individual/HUF is a s.194A deductor only if the immediately preceding year's turnover from a business exceeded ₹1 crore, or its gross receipts from a profession exceeded ₹50 lakh (s.194A(1) proviso; s.194C Explanation (i)(l)(B)); whether the client carries on a business or a profession is not recorded; the current year's books alone cannot establish this.
ask_client_text: Confirm previous-year turnover or gross receipts, and whether from a business or a profession.

findings.title_text: A ledger under Loans (Liability) is not in the client's list of loans: this test computed no clause 31 rows for it
limits_text: Not computed: this test runs clause 31, the s.269SS/269T test and the s.194A test only on the loans in the client's list. This ledger moved in the year and is not in it, so this test computed none of them for it (a cash entry on it may still be listed by the cash-payments test); its credits and debits are shown as the books hold them.

This notice removes and changes no clause 31 row or amount. It adds a question for the CA under clause 31, and a draft that answers clause 31 'Nil' is asked about it. A notice that turns out not to be a loan costs a question, not a wrong figure.
ask_client_text: Whether this ledger is a loan; if so, the lender, the lender's type (such as a bank, an NBFC or a person) and the loan statement.
